The '''LT-9000 Rendilii Interceptor''' was a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]-equipped starfighter designed and manufactured by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]]. The [[Chikarri]] [[Plako]] owned one such vessel, named ''[[Tasty Acorn]]''.
